sentences.en: Spacious houses are more financially attainable than they used to be.
sentences.zh: 宽敞的房子现在比以前更容易负担得起。

sentences.en: To set attainable, measurable goals is very important to successful language learning.
sentences.zh: 设定可实现、可衡量的目标对成功学习语言非常重要。

sentences.en: You need to set yourself attainable goals.
sentences.zh: 你需要为自己设定可实现的目标。
